items.title: Show HN: Take Voyager 1 apart, down to a single memory chip
items.description: Voyager 1 reached one light-day from Earth today. On the site you can: - see where both Voyagers are right now - open a nuclear battery to its 24 plutonium spheres - go into the data computer, down to a single memory chip - see how the Golden Record's cover explains how to play it - watch how Voyager 1 was fixed by radio - see which dish on Earth is listening to them, live I also made a 4-minute film from it: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kpzsRo-c1_A Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50548161 Points: 8 # Comments: 0
